verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs clearly describe short-lived session JWTs (expiry) and explicit claims of 'full session lifecycle' management including 'active device monitoring and session revocation' with per-device sign-out in the profile UI, covering expiry, refresh, and revocation on paper. However, a hands-on community report describes production token-refresh failures requiring emergency fixes ('had to wake up Sunday to fix failing token refreshes'), directly contradicting reliable refresh behavior in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of revocation being truly immediate/server-side propagated, documented refresh-token rotation mechanics, and corroboration that the reported refresh failures were resolved/rare rather than systemic.
